_note: All user-visible content lives here. Edit freely and restart; logic never depends on the wording. castsPerDay, rewardCapPerDay and rewardSchedule are the A/B knobs.

lifetimeReward._note: Experiment runs ~2 weeks. rewardSchedule[daysPlayed] is the fixed [roll1, roll2, roll3] payout for that day index (0 = user's very first day) — every user wins something on each of their first 7 days, no randomness. Days beyond the schedule pay nothing (totalBudget is already fully spent by day 7).

coinCredit._note: Fields sent to the internal Coin API (server-side only). {day} in the description is replaced with the product day the redemption happened on.

nav._note: Webview keeps no browser history. The back arrow posts GO_BACK to the RN shell when available; otherwise it fires this deeplink (same one the Bhagya surfaces use).

copy._note: Keep every label in simple, everyday words (tier-2/3 audience).
